props.name: Goblindorf
props.description: A swampy, wet, and murky area with decaying trees and waterlogged terrain.

props.name: Wald
props.description: Forest where the child runs toward.

props.name: Camp
props.description: A campsite that has been looted by goblins, with no valuable items left.

props.name: Swamp
props.description: A swampy area where tracking is difficult due to the terrain.

props.name: Tree
props.description: A tree near the campsite where a corpse was found.

props.name: Nebeliger Waldgebiet
props.description: Ein nebeliges Gebiet, in dem die Sicht eingeschränkt ist. Es gibt Bäume und schwarze Silhouetten, die sich durch den Nebel bewegen.

props.name: Nebeliger Wald
props.description: Ein bewaldetes Gebiet, in dem sich der Nebel dicht und kalt ausbreitet. Die Sichtweite ist stark eingeschränkt.

props.name: Steingebilde (verfallener Aussichtsturm)
props.description: Ein großes, verfallenes Steinkonstrukt, das einst möglicherweise ein Aussichtsturm oder Teil einer Burg gewesen sein könnte. Es ist eingestürzt und nicht mehr begehbar.

props.name: Norden
props.description: Die Richtung, in die sich die Spieler bewegen, nachdem sie den Kompass als Orientierungspunkt nutzen.

props.name: Between the Trees (area where characters are standing)
Dorf
props.description: Ein naturbelastetes Dorf mit kleinen Häusern auf einer Lichtung, einem kleinen Berg und zwei großen Bauernhöfen.

props.name: Haupthöher
props.description: A location with 19 total (possibly steps or levels).

props.name: Raum (Room)
props.description: A room located one floor below the current level, which cannot be accessed directly from the current position.

props.name: Previous Mission: Strange Creature in the Forest
Goblins
props.description: One of the factions involved in the planned attack on the village. They previously had a camp that was discovered and destroyed by guild members.

props.name: Goblin-Gott (Lugasch)
props.description: A trickster god of the goblins, known for causing mischief and attempting to harm others.

props.name: Esterossa's God
props.description: The deity worshipped by Esterossa, who is praying for divine intervention against Lugash.

props.name: Goblingötter
props.description: Ein fiktiver Glaubenssystem, das von Zuschauern gespielt wird und Glück oder Pech für die Spieler vermitteln kann.

props.summary: As the group approaches Goblindorf, they notice the terrain becoming increasingly swampy and difficult to navigate.
props.name: First encounter with the environment

props.summary: The party arrives at the edge of a swampy area. The environment is described as increasingly wet, muddy, and difficult to navigate. A distant campfire is visible in the distance, accompanied by an unpleasant smell.
props.name: First encounter with the swamp and distant camp

props.summary: The party decides to proceed carefully toward the campsite after detecting signs of danger or activity in the swamp.
props.name: Decision to move forward cautiously

props.summary: The group prepares to move forward. Celin is asked to stay on range, Cookie indicates they will remain nearby due to their ability to evade.
props.name: Group Readiness and Movement

props.summary: Cookie offers to go ahead, but later declines when Esterossa asks Celin to stay on range.
props.name: Cookie volunteers to move forward

props.summary: Esterossa decides to proceed without waiting for others.
props.name: Esterossa's decision to move forward

props.summary: Cookie chooses to remain close due to their ability to evade, ensuring they can keep up with the party.
props.name: Cookie's decision to stay near the group

props.summary: Cookie indicates they will stay near the range due to their ability to evade.
props.name: Cookie responds to Esterossa's request

props.summary: Cookie decides to stay near the group, citing their ability to evade as a reason.
props.name: Cookie chooses to stay nearby due to Evasion skill

props.summary: As the party approaches, a Goblin jumps out of the right tent and charges at them.
props.name: Goblin appears from the right tent

props.summary: Dodo makes an Angriffswurf with 2w12, hits the Goblin, and deals 5 damage. The Goblin is still moving forward.
props.name: Dodo's first attack on the Goblin

props.summary: The Goblin successfully attacks Dodo with a roll of 7 on a W20, dealing some damage. Dodo's Evasion is 4, which slightly reduces the impact.
props.name: Goblin attacks Dodo

props.summary: The Goblin attempted to attack Dodo, but due to his high armor (Rüstungsstärke of 9), the physical damage was reduced by 9 before being applied. The attack failed entirely as the resulting damage would have been zero.
props.name: Goblin's Attack Bounced Off Dodo's Armor

props.summary: Esterossa attempted to fly above the combat and strike from above with her axe or sword, positioning herself behind Dodo (the tank). The action was described as a deliberate decision to attack from an elevated position.
props.name: Esterossa's Aerial Strike Attempt

props.summary: Esterossa positions herself high above the battlefield, preparing to strike with her sword or axe.
props.name: Esterossa takes a high position and attacks from above

props.summary: Esterossa rolls for damage and successfully hits the Goblin. The Goblin is wounded but manages to escape.
props.name: Esterossa lands a successful hit on the Goblin

props.summary: Cookie summons Perry, his Schnabeltier, who uses its gift stachel to incapacitate and severely wound the Goblin. The Goblin is left unable to stand.
props.name: Cookie's Schnabeltier (Perry) defeats the Goblin

props.summary: Cookie rolls a successful attack against the Goblin, causing it to fall unconscious and not wake up.
props.name: Cookie defeats Goblin with precise attack

props.summary: The party discovers a rusted short sword (Kurzschwert), a wooden dagger (Holzener Dolch), and a healing potion (Heiltrank) at the Goblin's camp.
props.name: Discovery of Goblin loot

props.summary: Dodo and Esterossa search a tent, with Dodo asking Celin if she has recorded the healing potion or if he should do it.
props.name: Searching the Tent for Healing Potion

props.summary: Dodo searches the tent and reminds Hopf to write down his name. Esterossa confirms that Hopf is inside the tent.
props.name: Searching the Tent for Hopf

props.summary: Dodo asks Celin if she has written down the Heiltrank or if he should do it.
props.name: Checking for Heiltrank

props.summary: Dodo and Cookie discover a scroll in the Zelt (tent) that allows communication with nature, specifically trees and plants. The GM explains that while the Goblins may have overlooked it, the scroll is now available for use.
props.name: Discovery of Schriftrolle (scroll)

props.summary: Cookie points out a corpse found on a tree, indicating the presence of a dead body in the area.
props.name: Discovery of Leiche (corpse)

props.summary: The party searched the camp but found little of value, as goblins had already looted most items.
props.name: Searching the Camp

props.summary: Cookie discovered a corpse hanging from a tree.
props.name: Discovering a Corpse at the Tree

props.summary: Dodo noticed a chest that could be looted, but it was already open and had been searched before.
props.name: Finding a Chest

props.summary: A goblin emerged from the chest and attacked Dodo. The party fought back and eventually subdued the goblin.
props.name: Goblin Encounter in the Chest

props.summary: Cookie's Frettchen (Perry) attacks a Goblin, biting its foot and keeping it on its feet.
props.name: Frettchen attack Goblin

props.summary: Dodo pulls back his shield and strikes the Goblin with a Kolben, killing it.
props.name: Dodo uses Kolben to kill Goblin

props.summary: The group discovers a Leckerli (cookie) and possibly a piece of Hühnerkeule in the Kiste / Truhe.
props.name: Discovering Kiste / Truhe contents

props.summary: The Goblin takes its final breath after being struck by Dodo with the Kolben.
props.name: Goblin's last breath

props.summary: Dodo proposes taking a short rest or nap before proceeding.
props.name: Dodo suggests taking a nap

props.summary: Esterossa lights her torch, retrieves her sigil, and begins praying to her god as part of preparing for a short rest.
props.name: Esterossa prepares for rest

props.summary: Esterossa rolls dice to cast a spell that briefly illuminates the swamp with light before fading into a sigil.
props.name: Esterossa casts a spell using the Duality Dice

props.summary: The group discusses how to split the 8-hour sleep period into two watches, with Dodo volunteering for the first watch.
props.name: Waking shift arrangement discussed

props.summary: The GM asks if anyone has lost armor or taken damage, possibly leading to a status check.
props.name: Check for lost armor or damage

props.summary: Esterossa suggests a shift-based watch system, with Cookie and Dodo each taking two shifts of 4 hours each to cover an 8-hour sleep period. Dodo volunteers to start the first watch.
props.name: Shift in Watch Duty Assignment

props.summary: The group takes a short rest, during which they can repair armor, regain hit points, or prepare for combat. They choose to prepare, gaining two Hope points each.
props.name: Short Rest and Preparation

props.summary: Dodo volunteers to take the first watch, followed by Cookie and Marco. The group discusses who will sleep last and how long they can rest.
props.name: First Watch Assignment

props.summary: Esterossa takes a position to observe the surroundings, moving through the mist and gaining a better vantage point between the trees.
props.name: Esterossa positions herself in the fog

props.summary: The first night and watch pass without any problems. Esterossa sees, hears, or notices nothing suspicious in the fog.
props.name: First night passes without incident

props.summary: Cookie wakes up and positions himself on a tree stump, attempting to remain hidden. A Finesse roll is made.
props.name: Cookie wakes up and takes position on a tree stump

props.summary: Cookie rolls a critical success (two 1s) on his Finesse check, allowing him to remain undetected despite being on the tree stump.
props.name: Critical success in hiding

props.summary: While hidden, Cookie notices a creature moving through the fog. The GM allows him to react and describe his actions.
props.name: A creature is spotted moving through the fog

props.summary: Cookie uses her Schnabeltier to wake up the others without alerting the intruder.
props.name: Schnabeltier weckt die anderen

props.summary: Esterossa and Dodo make Perception checks to spot the intruder, but fail to understand what the Frettchen is trying to communicate.
props.name: Wahrnehmungswurf von Esterossa und Dodo

props.summary: Dodo attempts to perceive something but does not gain any Hope.
props.name: Dodo fails to gain Hope

props.summary: Cookie presents Dodo with a stone, symbolizing their friendship.
props.name: Cookie gives Dodo a stone as a gift of friendship

props.summary: The Frettchen conveys to Cookie that there is a horned creature hiding in the fog to the left of them.
props.name: Frettchen communicates information about a horned creature in the fog

props.summary: Esterossa becomes aware of the horned creature and expresses confusion about its presence.
props.name: Esterossa notices the horned creature and reacts with confusion

props.summary: Upon Esterossa's approach, the horned creature disappears into the fog.
props.name: The horned creature flees when Esterossa approaches

props.summary: Esterossa informs the group that she saw a figure moving around their camp.
props.name: Esterossa reports seeing someone in the camp

props.summary: After the encounter, the group goes back to sleep with one member on watch.
props.name: The group returns to sleep after the encounter

props.summary: As morning arrives, the fog dissipates, allowing for better visibility.
props.name: Morning comes and fog clears significantly

props.summary: Esterossa observes what appears to be a bridge or wooden construction ahead.
props.name: Esterossa spots a bridge or wooden structure in the distance

props.summary: Dodo takes initiative and offers to go first in the direction of the distant object.
props.name: Dodo volunteers to lead the group forward

props.summary: Esterossa expresses reluctance to get her shoes dirty, citing a sense of honor.
props.name: Esterossa refuses to walk through dirt due to honor

props.summary: Esterossa uses her Loreborn background and Knowledge trait to identify the creature on the hill as a Waldschrat, after rolling a 22 + 6 (from her background bonus).
props.name: Esterossa identifies the creature as a Waldschrat

props.summary: Cookie uses his Instinct trait to ask the Nature if the creature is good or evil. The GM responds that the Goblin-Götter are doing things again, and describes the creature's behavior.
props.name: Cookie asks the Nature for information about the creature

props.summary: The Goblin-Götter are doing things once more, as mentioned by the GM.
props.name: Goblin-Götter act again

props.summary: Cookie asks if the character nearby is good or evil, seeking information from the environment (the Nature).
props.name: Cookie asks about a character's alignment

props.summary: The GM confirms that Cookie is referring to 'the Nature', which is a valid entity in the game world.
props.name: GM clarifies that Nature is being referenced

props.summary: Cookie asks the Nature whether a stranger is good or bad.
props.name: Asking the Nature about a stranger

props.summary: The party approaches and examines the ruined stone structure, identifying it as a collapsed lookout tower. The GM notes that there is no entrance or way inside.
props.name: Exploration of Steingebilde (verfallener Aussichtsturm)

props.summary: A Knowledge check was suggested to determine the structure's original purpose, but no one had a high enough score. Cookie had 0 and Esterossa had -1.
props.name: Knowledge Check on Steingebilde

props.summary: A check on Instinct was requested for Cookie and Esterossa before attempting to climb the structure.
props.name: Instinct Check to Explore Steingebilde

props.summary: The party attempts to explore a collapsed structure but finds no entrance or way inside.
props.name: Exploration of the collapsed structure

props.summary: The GM interrupts the roll with a brief description of an event or scene, mentioning 'Ticken raus' (literally: 'tick out') and indicating something is visible.
props.name: GM's Interruption and Description

props.summary: Esterossa claims to see nothing at first, then points at a construct, accidentally hitting Cookie’s die instead.

props.summary: Cookie notices that their die has been hit and is now out of place.
props.name: Cookie Points Out the Die

props.summary: Esterossa decides to retreat back to the 'Tank' (likely a character or position), indicating a tactical decision.
props.name: Esterossa's Retreat to Tank

props.summary: Esterossa initially claims to see nothing but then points out a construct.
props.name: Esterossa notices something

props.summary: Cookie finds and retrieves their Würfel (die).
props.name: Cookie retrieves their die

props.summary: Cookie finds their Würfel (dice) on the ground.
props.name: Cookie locates their dice

props.summary: Esterossa sees something and points it out, but then realizes she was looking at Cookie's Würfel.

props.summary: Esterossa decides to move back down to their tank, likely for safety or strategy.
props.name: Esterossa moves toward the tank

props.summary: Esterossa unintentionally engages with a construct, causing a brief interruption.
props.name: Esterossa accidentally interacts with a construct

props.summary: Esterossa momentarily loses focus and mistakenly speaks to a construct before realizing her mistake.
props.name: Esterossa loses focus and accidentally addresses a construct

props.summary: Esterossa decides to return to the group's 'Tank' for support.
props.name: Esterossa returns to the group's Tank

props.summary: Cookie is asked to perform an Agility check as they descend from the stones.
props.name: Agility Check by Cookie

props.summary: A mysterious force from the sky attempts to push stones onto Dodo, but Cookie performs a backward somersault and avoids them.

props.summary: A Knowledge check is initiated by Cookie to identify the Goblin-God responsible for the stone attack.

props.summary: As the party moves forward, they see something between the trees rise up suddenly.
props.name: Between the Trees Appears

props.summary: Ein Wildschwein stürzt aus dem Nichts auf die Gruppe zu, aber es rennt an ihnen vorbei und prallt gegen einen Baum. Die Kreatur wird ohnmächtig und stellt keine Gefahr dar.
props.name: Wildschwein erscheint und rennt an die Gruppe vorbei

props.summary: Die Gruppe macht einen Instinktwurf, um das Verhalten des Wildschweins zu verstehen. Es wird festgestellt, dass es aus Panik handelte und keine Gefahr darstellt.
props.name: Instinktwurf zur Wahrnehmung des Wildschweins

props.summary: Esterossa proposes that Cookie use her natural affinity to communicate with the environment and find a new steed.
props.name: Esterossa suggests talking to nature for a new mount

props.summary: Cookie uses a natural spell-like ability fueled by Hope to attempt to communicate with and calm the confused wild boar.
props.name: Cookie attempts to calm the wild boar using Hope

props.summary: Despite Cookie's efforts, the wild boar remains confused and retreats back into the dense undergrowth (Dickicht).
props.name: Wild boar is unimpressed and flees into the Dickicht

props.summary: Esterossa tries to offer natural provisions to the wild boar, but it is revealed that no food was available.
props.name: Esterossa attempts to offer food to the wild boar

props.summary: The GM informs the players they have approximately one hour left to complete their unspecified mission or task (Auftrag).
props.name: Time constraint for completing Auftrag (unspecified)

props.summary: Cookie reveals that they have a Nomadenbeutel containing basic supplies, a 5-Fuß-Seil, and a Fackel.
props.name: Nomadenbeutel Contents Revealed

props.summary: The GM informs the party that they have approximately one hour to complete their Auftrag.
props.name: Time Constraint Given

props.summary: Esterossa moves closer to the mountain and begins observing the environment, noting that some goblins are visible while others are not.
props.name: Esterossa approaches the mountain and observes surroundings

props.summary: The goblins in the Goblin Lager are celebrating their recent victories, appearing somewhat drunk and in a festive mood.
props.name: Goblin Lager celebration

props.summary: Both Esterossa and Cookie attempt to move stealthily toward the mountain. They roll for Agility/Finesse, with Esterossa rolling a 15 (4-point success) and Cookie rolling a hit.
props.name: Esterossa and Cookie attempt stealth on the mountain

props.summary: A drunken figure appears and urinates down the hill, prompting an Agility check for Esterossa to avoid being caught in the 'dusche'. The GM describes the scene and the outcome of the roll.

props.summary: Cookie entfernt den Kopf eines Kinder-Goblins mit einem Stärkewurf, wobei der Körper des Goblins vom Hubi herunterrutscht und der Kopf in Cookies Hand bleibt.
props.name: Goblin-Kopf-Entfernung

props.summary: Die Goblins versammeln sich vor dem Hauptgebäude, was als potenziell gefährlich, aber auch informativ für die Spieler wahrgenommen wird.

props.summary: Ein großer Goblin namens Schleichfurz spricht seine Goblins an und erklärt, dass sie alle Menschen ausgelöscht haben und nun weiterziehen werden.
props.name: Schleichfurz' Ansprache

props.summary: The Goblins are seen celebrating and retreating, with the Goblin-Mage taking refuge in the Gebäude.
props.name: Goblins retreat and take cover

props.summary: The group decides not to engage the Goblins directly and instead uses Stealth tactics to move through the area.
props.name: Decision to use Stealth and avoid confrontation

props.summary: It is revealed that the village was likely destroyed, with its tents dismantled by the Goblins.
props.name: Discovery of abandoned campsite

props.summary: Cookie reveals that their Frettchen has died and is now contained within a Pokéball.
props.name: Frettchen's death and containment in Pokéball

props.summary: The group discusses using the Frettchen as bait to lure the Goblins into the Gebäude for an ambush.
props.name: Planning to lure Goblins with Frettchen

props.summary: Dodo and Esterossa perform Stealth and Finesse checks to remain undetected while planning their ambush strategy.
props.name: Stealth and Finesse checks conducted

props.summary: Esterossa initiates a Finesse check, possibly to gain advantage in stealth or another action.
props.name: Esterossa calls for a Finesse check

props.name: Esterossa uses Finesse check

props.summary: Esterossa uses two Hauptpunkte to acquire a Vorteil, which allows her to roll two W6 dice.
props.name: Esterossa spends Hauptpunkte to gain a Vorteil

props.summary: As the group approaches Freddchen, a large and ugly rat (later identified as a Goblin) is noticed. The Goblin is followed by two other Goblins, one of whom is fast and throws a spear that misses.
props.name: Goblin spotted near Blume

props.summary: The Goblins continue to approach the Frettchen (Freddchen), with one shouting 'Now we have you! You stupid Frettchen!'

props.summary: Two goblins spring forward and attack Mikasa, with the first attack dealing 10 damage.
props.name: Goblins attack Mikasa

props.summary: Dodo voluntarily takes damage from a second goblin attack, using armor and strength to reduce it to zero.
props.name: Dodo takes damage to protect others

props.summary: A second goblin attacks Dodo with a 21 roll, dealing 5 damage before being partially mitigated by armor and strength.

props.summary: Esterossa swings his axe at a goblin, rolling a 17 with an attack roll of 9 and 6.
props.name: Esterossa attempts to attack a Goblin

props.summary: Esterossa attempts to strike an enemy with her axe, rolling a successful attack.

props.summary: Esterossa successfully lands an attack with a roll of 17, which is the result of rolling a 9 and a 6.

props.summary: Esterossa attacks Neumarkscher Schaden with enough force that one of its arms becomes limp.

props.summary: Dodo successfully hits an enemy, allowing them to make a 'Schadensruf' (damage cry).
props.name: Dodo lands a successful hit on the enemy

props.summary: Cookie successfully lands an attack and is allowed to make a damage cry.
props.name: Successful Attack with Damage Cry

props.summary: Nachdem Dodo einen Schlag gegen den Goblin landet, rollen plötzlich Fässer auf die Gruppe zu. Alle Charaktere müssen einen Agilitätscheck machen, außer Esterossa, die mit zwei Hop-Points extra Würfe erhält.

props.summary: Ein Goblin, der bereits gefressen hat, schluckt einen Trank und wächst erheblich. Er wird deutlich größer und greift die Gruppe an.

props.summary: The creature (referred to as 'der') had already eaten heavily, lost an arm, dropped his bow, and drew a weapon called 'Kurzdeutsch'. He grew significantly larger and charged at the party.

props.summary: Dodo exclaimed 'Schwein!' (which translates to 'Pig!') in response to the creature, likely indicating recognition or disgust.

props.summary: The GM indicated that a roll of 15 was made, which successfully hit. The group is now allowed to calculate damage from this attack.
props.name: Attack Attempt and Damage Calculation

props.summary: The character using the bow loses an arm and drops it, then draws a weapon called 'Kurzdeutsch', which has grown significantly larger. The entity (likely an enemy) charges toward Dodo with intent to strike.
props.name: Bogen gebruikt en arm verloren

props.summary: A roll of 15 is made, and damage is calculated as a result.
props.name: Schaden berechnen na 15-tal

props.summary: Cookie's Frettchen uses a main action to interrupt the Goblin climbing onto the boxes, dealing significant damage with a Stachel. The GM rolls for this attack and confirms it hits successfully.
props.name: Frettchen interrupts Goblin

props.summary: Esterossa takes advantage of the Goblin being interrupted, targeting his remaining arm to try and detach it.
props.name: Esterossa targets Goblin's arm

props.summary: Esterossa targets the Goblin's remaining arm, attempting to rip it off so he can be incapacitated.
props.name: Esterossa attempts to disarm Goblin

props.summary: Esterossa clarifies that there are two attacks being made, not one.

props.summary: Dodo tries to break free from the barrels they are trapped in and is asked by the GM to make a Strength check before doing so.
props.name: Dodo attempts to free themselves from the barrels

props.summary: Esterossa takes 4 points of damage, but remains focused on the target. This event is referenced again when the GM mentions that Esterossa still has focus.

props.summary: After Cookie's successful shot, Mikasa uses her axe (Axt) to decapitate the fallen goblin.

props.summary: Esterossa insists on going directly to the Obermacker, indicating urgency or a specific goal.

props.summary: Dodo suggests going around the building instead of directly up.
props.name: Decision to go around the building

props.summary: GM mentions the need to prepare for an imminent attack and suggests working with the Magier.
props.name: Preparation for an upcoming attack

props.summary: The group moves forward and begins ascending the stairs when they hear whispering. The GM mentions preparing for an attack and suggests working with the Magier.

props.summary: Valerie and Rotunas receive an Armbrust from Bürgermeister in exchange for Gold, which they are allowed to use for the defense of die Stadt. The Armbrust is later identified as a Crossbow (Advanced or Improved), with Rotunas noting the existence of a Legendary Crossbow of Demolition.
props.name: Crossbow acquisition and ownership transfer

props.summary: Tindrell is brought into the tavern by Rotunas and Valerie. The GM notes that Tindrell has guests, including Rotunas and Valeria (later identified as Ballot).
props.name: Tindrell enters the tavern with Rotunas and Valerie

props.summary: Valerie comments on being mistaken for a man, and the GM explains that it is difficult to distinguish between characters. Valerie responds by saying she is not angry and that women should support each other.
props.name: Valerie's identity confusion

props.summary: The barkeeper offers drinks. Valerie orders a beer and begins drinking it, while Rotunas asks for wine and receives a glass of Becher Wein.
props.name: Ordering drinks at the tavern

props.summary: Valerie uses a Hope and an Experience point to determine whether she can tolerate the beer. The GM confirms that she can, despite it not being high quality.
props.name: Valerie's drinking ability tested with Hope and Experience

props.summary: Rotunas asks for the barkeeper's name and is greeted by Hubert, who introduces himself as Nip. Rotunas drinks wine carefully to avoid needing a Strength roll.
props.name: Rotunas' interaction with the barkeeper (Hubert)

props.summary: An old man in the tavern offers assistance in preparing for a potential goblin attack, stating that every villager must help defend the village.
props.name: Villager Offers Help to Fortify the Village

props.summary: Rotunas informs the group that a Goblin attack is coming soon and that the village needs to be fortified.
props.name: Goblin attack imminent

props.summary: Rotunas proposes either setting a trap or relying on the guards to defend the village, acknowledging that they are not warriors and cannot fight effectively.
props.name: Rotunas suggests setting a trap or relying on the guards

props.summary: Rotunas asserts that the villagers must all participate in defending their home, implying a shift from passive waiting to active involvement.
props.name: Rotunas encourages collective defense

props.summary: The GM explains that only the guards Kerl and Brock are capable fighters, while Berthold is not a good fighter and others like the blacksmith (Der Schmied) have some skill but no one else has real combat talent.
props.name: GM Describes Combat Readiness of Village Inhabitants

props.summary: Rotunas questions two individuals about whether they are travelers or villagers.
props.name: Rotunas Asks About Identity of Travelers

props.summary: The GM describes Elisa as being in a good position to defend, but notes that the morale of others is low. Suggests that encouragement or a speech might be needed.
props.name: GM Describes Elisa's Combat Role and Morale Concerns

props.summary: Valerie mentions a past game she and Rotunas played, involving throwing fireballs like hot potatoes. She also notes that the group has powerful mages from the Guild.
props.name: Valerie Shares Past Magician Game with Rotunas

props.summary: Valerie mentions a past game with Rotunas where they juggle fireballs, similar to tossing hot potatoes.
props.name: Valerie and Rotunas' Fireball Juggling

props.summary: Nip becomes extremely drunk and collapses dramatically after the performance, causing a comedic scene.
props.name: Nip's Drunken Collapse

props.summary: Valerie decides not to spend Hope to generate Hit Points, instead opting to check on Rotunas directly and ensure he is in a stable condition.
props.name: Valerie attempts to check on Rotunas without using Hope

props.summary: After being told to go home and rest by Valerie, Rotunas leaves the building without listening.
props.name: Rotunas leaves the building

props.summary: Valerie asks what time it is, and the GM reveals that it's 17:00.
props.name: Time check

props.summary: Rudi is told by Valerie to go home and rest, and he leaves without listening. This event occurs in response to Valerie's instruction.
props.name: Rudi leaves the building

props.summary: The character exits the building without listening to Valerie.
props.name: Character leaves the building

props.summary: Valerie checks the time, which is 5 PM, and the GM acknowledges that they've been working too long.
props.name: Time check and realization of overexertion

props.summary: Die Bauern bieten vier große Barrikaden an, die schnell hergestellt werden können. Die Spieler entscheiden später, wo sie platziert werden.
props.name: Bauern offerieren Barrikaden

props.summary: Valerie schlägt vor, ein Loch zu buddeln und spitze Holzdinger darin zu platzieren, um eine Falle zu bauen.
props.name: Vorschlag für eine Falle

props.summary: Die Bauern bieten Barrikaden an, die Rotunas und Valerie entscheiden können, wo sie platziert werden.
props.name: Barrikaden Angebot von Bauern

props.summary: Rotunas und Valerie entscheiden, die Herstellung der Barrikaden zu beginnen, aber noch nicht wo sie platziert werden sollen.
props.name: Entscheidung über Barrikaden

props.summary: The farmers offer to build four large barrikaden for the group, which they can decide where to place.
props.name: Offer of Barrikaden by Farmers

props.summary: Rotunas indicates that the group will consider where to place the barrikaden but allows the farmers to begin construction immediately.
props.name: Decision to Consider Placement of Barrikaden

props.summary: The Bauern offer the party the ability to have four large barricades built quickly, with the option of deciding where they are placed.
props.name: Bauern offer to build barricades

props.summary: Die Gruppe erhält acht Stück Holz für eine Palisade, die sie zur Verteidigung nutzen können. Die Entscheidung wird getroffen, wo diese platziert werden sollen.
props.name: Feld mit Zaun/Palisade beschaffen

props.summary: Valerie nutzt eine Finesse-Wurf-Aktion, um Holz aus einem Feld zu entwenden. Die Bauern bemerken dies zwar, sind aber nicht direkt eingeschritten, da Valerie traurig aussah.
props.name: Valerie stiehlt Holz aus dem Feld

props.summary: Others notice Valerie’s action and are not entirely pleased. One individual appears disapproving but does not speak out, likely due to her demeanor.
props.name: Reactions to Valerie's Action

props.summary: Valerie approaches the forge where Schmied is working. The other workers are not enthusiastic about her presence, but they do not confront her directly due to her appearance.
props.name: Valerie enters the forge

props.summary: Valerie says 'Okay, und jetzt ab.' and departs.
props.name: Valerie leaves the scene

props.summary: The GM describes how the Schmied sees Valerie but is not enthusiastic, with one of them looking 'abgefuckt' (disheveled), though he says nothing because Valerie looks small and sad.
props.name: GM describes Schmied's reaction to Valerie

props.summary: Valerie arrives at the location of the smithy and is greeted by the sound of hammering, indicating that Schmied is present.
props.name: Arrival at the Smithy

props.summary: As the party enters Hof, they are approached by a young woman who appears unusually small. The GM introduces this character as part of the setting.
props.name: Encounter with the young woman at Hof

props.summary: Valerie uses fire from a shot that traveled through the forest.
props.name: Fire in the Forest

props.summary: Valerie and Rotunas are discussing how to plan the defense of a location by analyzing potential attack points, removing them from consideration, and identifying a single point to defend. They consider using a specific style of writing (Kriseleien) rather than their own script.
props.name: Planning a defensive strategy

props.summary: The group decides not to use palisades for a bunker but instead uses tables (Tische) and other structures like Spitzdingern for additional defense.
props.name: Decision to Use Tische as Additional Defense

props.summary: The group finalizes the placement of palisades, using six of them and considering two more to connect trees or reinforce key points.
props.name: Final Placement of Palisades

props.summary: Valerie and Rotunas discuss positioning the Spitzdingern to control movement through an area, with Valerie suggesting placing them in a way that forces enemies to pass through specific points.
props.name: Setting up Spitzdingern for defense

props.summary: Valerie and Rotunas discuss the placement of Bärenfalle traps to deter enemies. They decide on strategic locations, including one in the middle and between gaps.
props.name: Deployment of Traps

props.summary: The GM outlines which NPCs will participate in combat: a bowman, a blacksmith with an Axt, Fette, and Asteroid-Schild, two guards, and later a Drunken Monk who joins only if the party is losing.
props.name: NPC Combat Roles Assigned

props.summary: The GM announces that the current Mission has reached its end, and the Questziel for today is complete. This marks the conclusion of this phase of the session.
props.name: Mission Completion

props.summary: Players are given control over figures (soldiers, farmers) to position them on the battlefield for the upcoming confrontation.
props.name: Deployment of Figures

props.summary: A plan is devised where one of the farmers will act as bait, luring enemies toward a trap before retreating.
props.name: Plan to Lure Enemy with Farmer

props.summary: The day ends with players preparing for the next mission by sending a message to the Guild requesting support.
props.name: End of Day and Preparation for Next Mission

props.summary: The party ends their day by resting and sending a message to the Gilde for support in the future.
props.name: End of the Day

props.summary: Rotunas suggests robbing the old merchant's house, but the GM declines, stating that the day has ended and it is now night.
props.name: Attempted House Robbery

props.summary: Rotunas suggests looting the old merchant's house, but the GM declines, stating that it is already night and the scenario is set for a future event.
props.name: Attempt to loot the old merchant's house

props.summary: The GM mentions that the setup for an upcoming attack has already been prepared, indicating that this will be a key event in the near future.
props.name: Setup for future attack

props.summary: The GM announces that a Parallelmission will occur alongside the main mission, indicating that two missions are happening simultaneously.
props.name: Parallelmission announced
